facts.fact: Conrin 的灰衣派在蓝厅内向邻座动手，政变当场爆开
facts.anchor: Conrin’s grey-clad faction turned on their neighbours

facts.fact: 绿卫队长 Perin 提着 Ademar 公爵的头进场，宣布倒戈
facts.anchor: the captain was carrying Ducal Ademar’s head

facts.fact: Perin 明说投靠 Alar 是因为大哥给的钱更多
Elise 两箭射穿 Perin 喉咙，血溅在她的天鹅罩袍上
facts.anchor: Like Sanafin, his blood flew out

facts.fact: 一群穿黑衣、不披甲的老兵跟着 Elise 冲进来，喊着为 Isen 复仇
Liran 抓住 Alar 的头骨把他摔向砖地，当众砸碎
facts.anchor: throwing his son by the skull to the floor

facts.fact: 她下令抓捕灰衣与红衣两派，只留自己的近卫
facts.anchor: Arrest all other than my own personal guards

facts.fact: 满厅各族贵族跪在血里向她鞠躬，只有 Elise 站着
